outgoing.name: Norway
outgoing.excerpt: Jómsvíkinga saga tells that in 986, they attacked Haakon Jarl in Norway and were defeated in the Battle of Hjörungavágr.

outgoing.name: Odin
outgoing.excerpt: Jomsvikings were a company of Viking mercenaries of the 900s and 1000s, dedicated to the worship of such deities as Odin and Thor.
